record_title: Exact renewal-tail bias and root-n window thresholds for next-token surprise
provenance: SCOPE Phase II scientific record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: Exact formulas require atomless block marks. The root-n theorem assumes finite second block-length moment and windows o(sqrt(n)); only the one-sided forward-window estimator is covered. The full theorem/proof text of Chandra and Thangaraj (ISIT 2024, DOI 10.1109/ISIT57864.2024.10619664) was not inspected, leaving residual originality risk from duplication-specific prior work.
